review.why: Rewrites weak resume bullets into achievement statements using X-Y-Z, STAR and CAR formulas with examples.
review.summary: Transforms duty-style resume bullets into achievement-focused ones using the X-Y-Z, STAR and CAR frameworks, action verbs and metrics, with many before and after examples.
strengths: Easy to apply bullet by bullet
cautions: Examples show invented-looking metrics; user must supply real numbers
